name: Ghoul — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Ghoul from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Ghoul" but are not part of the Ghoul entry, which is unchanged.

Feats for Ghouls

The following feats are intended to be used by ghouls (including ghasts and lacedons), but could make interesting options for many other types of undead as well.

Variant: Ghoul, Desert Ghul (CR 1)

[Source]

Desert ghuls lack the pallid stretched flesh of a standard ghoul, instead having an ethnicity and complexion more akin to tribesmen of desert areas. They also lack the starved frame of their kin if they have used their cannibalistic healing in the last 24 hours.

Cannibalistic Healing (Su)

So long as the desert ghul has fed upon the flesh of a dead creature with the same creature type as the desert ghul within the last 24 hours, it has fast healing equal to its Cha modifier (usually +2).

This replaces a ghoul’s disease special attack.

Change Shape (Su)

Hyena, beast shape I any bonus to Constitution is instead added to Charisma.

This replaces a ghoul’s channel resistance +2.
